column7: Revocations (role, group, permission, share, ACL, token, session and PAT revoke, user suspend/deactivate/delete, SCIM deprovision, break-glass revoke, expiry sweeps, invitation revoke, request withdraw, risk-exception revoke) wrote a plain best-effort audit row after their commit with no record, so a refused append or a crash lost the row for good. AUDIT-TX-3 commits each with a pending_audit_events record of the row it owes and appends it after the commit and cache eviction, with the existing backfill as the safety net. Red on main: every append-error, effect-then-error, panic and crash-at-append case (31 kinds); green after on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
